_readme: Apex domains used to sample each registry's WHOIS output format.
A TLD only needs an entry when the probe's candidate ladder cannot find a
live record on its own. The ladder tries, in order:
2. the WHOIS host minus its 'whois.' prefix, when that leaves an apex
Most registries answer for nic.<tld>. The entries below are the ones that
do not: the name is reserved (om, qa, cn), restricted (nz, pk), or the TLD
sells only at the third level (il, mm, bw). Every value here was verified
to return a real record on 2026-07-16.
